stemMd: Two resistors connect directly across the same ideal battery terminals. Which quantity is the same for both?
explanationMd: Parallel components share the same pair of nodes and therefore the same voltage. Their currents and powers can differ because resistance and thermal properties may differ.

distractorRationale.b: The resistors need not be equal.
distractorRationale.d: Power depends on resistance at fixed voltage.
